items.title: Support validate storyId JSON alias without silent diagnostic fallback
items.context: Normalize validate args so storyId aliases story, conflict fails, and JSON body writes story test-evidence instead of silently becoming read-only diagnostic validate.
items.userSees: lattice validate {"storyId":"B-xxxx","json":true} 刷新对应 story 的 test-evidence；如果参数冲突会明确报错。

happy.desc: validate JSON body with storyId writes/refreshes test-evidence.json for that story.

edge.desc: validate --story continues to work and no-story validate remains diagnostic/read-only.

adversarial.desc: passing both story and a different storyId fails instead of choosing one silently.

verificationEvidence.note: After merging main and rebuilding, validation-protocol smoke confirms JSON storyId validate writes story test-evidence instead of silently falling back to diagnostic validate.
Same smoke confirms --story continues to write evidence and no-story validate remains diagnostic/read-only without creating story state.
Same smoke confirms conflicting story and storyId values fail explicitly before validation or persistence.

items.title: Render phase-aware scope freshness guidance
items.context: Change scope protection next-action so stale/missing review bindings still guide REVIEW gate, while TEST/DONE surfaces explain advisory vs blocking behavior accurately.
items.userSees: TEST 阶段不会再看到 before REVIEW→TEST 的误导提示；blocking scope failures still show hard recovery commands.

happy.desc: REVIEW stale/missing binding still instructs review_run_start before REVIEW→TEST.

edge.desc: TEST stale review binding renders as post-review advisory/delivery-review guidance, not REVIEW→TEST instruction.

adversarial.desc: path/semantic/guard fail remains blocking and is not softened by the new TEST advisory copy.

verificationEvidence.note: Semantic scope guard smoke confirms REVIEW stale or missing binding still points to review_run_start before REVIEW-to-TEST.
Same smoke confirms TEST stale review binding renders post-review advisory delivery-review guidance instead of REVIEW-to-TEST instruction.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:semantic-scope-guard-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Semantic scope and flow stability smokes confirm path semantic and guard failures remain blocking and are not softened by advisory copy.

items.title: Expose owner-lease takeover meta options in CLI help
items.context: Owner gate already consumes takeover/forceTakeover before schema validation; help should present these common owner recovery flags for owner-gated commands.
items.userSees: story_advance/validate/checklist_update help shows --takeover and --forceTakeover with stale-vs-active lease semantics.

happy.desc: owner-gated command help includes takeover and forceTakeover guidance.

edge.desc: read-only command help does not imply takeover is needed.

adversarial.desc: help change does not alter owner gate behavior; active takeover still requires forceTakeover and logs event.

verificationEvidence.note: Command ownership contract confirms owner-gated command help exposes --takeover and --forceTakeover, including story-targeted validate guidance.
Same contract confirms readOnly reviewerWrite and mainSharedMutating command help does not advertise takeover recovery.
Story owner lease smoke confirms active foreign lease still requires --forceTakeover, stale takeover semantics and audit events remain intact.

items.title: Clarify scope-warning recovery path after REVIEW
items.context: Scope warnings should distinguish advisory shadow warnings from blocking scope failures and point to acknowledge, rollback DEV, or delivery reviewer verification as appropriate.
items.userSees: scope warnings explain whether they block and what exact command/path to use next, reducing false alarm during TEST/DONE.

happy.desc: scope warning output mentions advisory/not blocking when mode is shadow/warn.

edge.desc: later-phase necessary out-of-scope expansion points to scope_contract_acknowledge or rollback DEV.

adversarial.desc: scope_contract_set phase limits remain unchanged and warnings do not become silent pass.

verificationEvidence.note: Scope-contract smoke confirms shadow/warn transition output says advisory and not blocking, and names scope_contract_acknowledge recovery.
Same smoke confirms TEST-phase warnings point to rolling back to DEV to acknowledge or delivery reviewer verification.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Command ownership and flow stability smokes confirm scope command phase policy remains unchanged and warnings do not become silent pass.

items.title: Integrate parallel fixes and prove lifecycle gates still fail closed
items.context: Merge the three implementation branches, resolve conflicts in cli-engine/verifier/scope tests, then run build, targeted smoke, validation protocol, owner lease smoke, scope smoke, flow stability, and process-fact contract.
items.userSees: 所有修复在一个 story 中交付，验证 transcript 清楚显示 validate evidence、scope hints、owner help 都按预期工作。

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build and targeted smoke commands pass after integration.

edge.desc: validation protocol, owner lease smoke, semantic scope smoke, flow stability smoke all pass.

adversarial.desc: process fact contract remains valid and no gate-evidence command is downgraded to read-only accidentally.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Integrated HEAD builds cleanly after main merge; validate alias and owner-help targeted smokes pass on the rebuilt local dist.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:story-owner-lease-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:semantic-scope-guard-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:scope-contract-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Owner lease, semantic scope, scope contract, and flow stability smokes all pass after merging main and fixing the dispatch phase-tools drift exposed by that merge.
Process fact contract verifies validate/gate-evidence command semantics and confirms new dispatch policy/watch/auto commands are aligned between command-policy and DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.
